is_anopheles.evidence: The study investigates field populations of Anopheles gambiae s.s. and Anopheles funestus in Vallée du Kou, Burkina Faso (Page 3).

reports_target_markers.evidence: The study tested for the Vgsc kdr mutation (L995F/kdr-west) in An. gambiae using PCR (Page 3, 'Species and molecular forms of An. gambiae identification and kdr mutation distribution').

reports_extractable_genotype_data.evidence: The paper only mentions that 44 An. gambiae were tested by PCR (39 M form, 5 S form) and states 'The kdr gene was detected only in the all S form tested in PCR (n = 5)' (Page 5). No specific genotype counts (RR/RS/SS) or allele counts/frequencies are provided.

african_field_population.evidence: Mosquitoes were collected from households in village VK6, Vallée du Kou, south-western Burkina Faso between September and November 2003 (Page 3).

is_primary_study.evidence: This is a primary empirical field study evaluating personal protection of LLINs and mosquito resistance markers.

sub_country_location.evidence: Village VK6, Vallée du Kou, near Bobo-Dioulasso, Burkina Faso (4° 24' 42" W, 11° 23' 14" N) (Page 3).

temporal_resolution_within_3y.evidence: Mosquito collections took place from September to November 2003 (Page 3).

duplicate_risk.evidence: Routine field study of bed net efficacy conducted in 2003 in VK6 village, Burkina Faso.

supplement.evidence: No supplementary files are referenced for genotype data.

assessment.summary: The paper evaluated the personal protection of Olyset and PermaNet LLINs in VK6 village, Burkina Faso in 2003. PCR was performed on 44 An. gambiae mosquitoes to determine molecular form and test for the kdr mutation, but no extractable genotype counts (RR/RS/SS) or allele frequencies were reported beyond stating that kdr was detected in all 5 S-form mosquitoes analyzed.
exclusion_reasons: Does not report extractable genotype counts (RR/RS/SS) or allele frequencies/counts for the target marker, only stating that the kdr gene was detected in S-form mosquitoes (n=5).
